symbols.name: ADAA1
symbols.summary: Generalised first-order Antiderivative Anti-Aliasing (ADAA) function. Implements a first-order ADAA approximation to reduce aliasing in nonlinear audio processing.

params.name: EPS
params.description: a threshold for switching between safe and ill-conditioned paths

params.name: f
params.description: a function that we want to process with ADAA

symbols.name: ADAA2
symbols.summary: Generalised second-order Antiderivative Anti-Aliasing (ADAA) function. Implements a second-order ADAA approximation for even better aliasing reduction at the cost of additional computation.

params.name: EPS
params.description: a threshold for switching between safe and ill-conditioned paths

params.name: f
params.description: a function that we want to process with ADAA

symbols.name: arccos
symbols.summary: First-order ADAA acos(). The domain of this function is [-1.0; 1.0]; its theoretical range is [π; 0.0].

symbols.name: arccos2
symbols.summary: Second-order ADAA acos(). The domain of this function is [-1.0; 1.0]; its theoretical range is [π; 0.0]. Note that this function is not accurate for low-amplitude or low-frequency input signals. In that case, the first-order ADAA arccos() can be used.

symbols.name: acosh1
symbols.summary: First-order ADAA acosh(). The domain of this function is ℝ >= 1.0; its theoretical range is ℝ >= 0.0.

symbols.name: acosh2
symbols.summary: Second-order ADAA acosh(). The domain of this function is ℝ >= 1.0; its theoretical range is ℝ >= 0.0. Note that this function is not accurate for low-frequency input signals. In that case, the first-order ADAA acosh() can be used.

symbols.name: sine2

symbols.name: arcsin

symbols.name: arcsin2
symbols.summary: Second-order ADAA asin(). The domain of this function is [-1.0, 1.0]; its theoretical range is [-π/2.0; π/2.0]. Note that this function is not accurate for low-frequency input signals. In that case, the first-order ADAA asin() can be used.
